claims: Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place on Saturday, March 28, 2026 at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle.
The main event is a middleweight bout between former champion Israel Adesanya and Joe Pyfer.
The UFC Seattle main card begins at 8 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card begins at 5 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
The UFC Seattle main card features a women’s flyweight co-main event bout between Alexa Grasso and Maycee Barber.
The UFC Seattle main card features a welterweight bout between Michael Chiesa and Niko Price.
The UFC Seattle main card features a featherweight bout between Julian Erosa and Lerryan Douglas.
The UFC Seattle main card features a middleweight bout between Yousri Belgaroui and Mansur Abdul-Malik.
The UFC Seattle main card features a lightweight bout between Terrance McKinney and Kyle Nelson.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card features a lightweight bout between Tofiq Musayev and Ignacio Bahamondes.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card features a lightweight bout between Lance Gibson Jr. and Chase Hooper.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card features a heavyweight bout between Tyrell Fortune and Marcin Tybura.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card features a women’s flyweight bout between Casey O’Neill and Gabriella Fernandes.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card features a light heavyweight bout between Navajo Stirling and Bruno Lopes.
The UFC Seattle preliminary card features a bantamweight bout between Ricky Simon and Adrian Yanez.
